Bill.BriefDescription: Providing tax incentives for employers providing physical fitness services to employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing tax incentives for employers providingphysical fitness services to employees; adding a new section to chapter82.04 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In computing tax, there may be deducted from the measure of tax,amounts paid to or on behalf of employees as financial incentives forphysical fitness services. Employers must provide the financialincentives to their own employees. Amounts that may be deducted underthis section include, but are not limited to, monthly dues for gymmemberships, health club memberships, fitness club memberships, orother membership dues paid to persons engaging within this state in thebusiness of providing physical fitness services.
